plan.question: What explains the N225 event: Japan-local factor, regional Asia co-move, US/global risk, JPY, policy, or fundamentals?
plan.next_best_evidence: PIT-aligned same-day Asia returns plus PRIOR US-session returns/VIX/USDJPY
plan.why: It separates a Japan/regional Asia shock from a US-global lead without lookahead
plan.source: GOE prices DB (yahoo), completed daily bars
plan.period: event 2026-11-06; prior US session 2026-11-05; trailing 90 sessions

decision_rule.global: prior US session SPY < -1% AND VIX > 0
decision_rule.reversal: N225 cumulative return over next 3 sessions > 0
decision_rule.alignment: Asia same-day; US/FX previous US session; no same-date future US close

plan.pit_note: US same-calendar-date close is after the Asia close and is therefore not used.

evidence.alignment: Asia same-day; US/FX previous US session; no same-date future US close

local_asia_test.interpretation: TOPIX co-move supports a broad Japan/local factor; association only

global_lead_test.interpretation: prior US selloff/VIX spike is consistent with a global lead

asia_regional_test.interpretation: Taiwan/Korea co-move supports regional Asia; tech-specific attribution not identified

fx_test.interpretation: small prior FX move cannot explain a -6% equity move by itself

reversal_test.interpretation: measured only from bars after the event through as-of

H-EQJP-LOCAL.label: Japan broad local market factor
H-EQJP-LOCAL.note: Broad co-move; not an independent instrument and not causal proof.

H-EQJP-GLOBAL.label: US/global risk lead
H-EQJP-GLOBAL.note: Prior US session sold off and VIX spiked before Asia opened; consistent with transmission. The later same-date US close is not used.

H-EQJP-FX.label: JPY/cross-border flow
H-EQJP-FX.note: Small prior FX move cannot explain the equity move by itself.

H-EQJP-POLICY.label: Policy/regulatory event
H-EQJP-POLICY.note: No scheduled event on 2026-11-06 in config/events.yaml; not enough to rule out policy news.

H-EQJP-FUND.label: Japan fundamentals/earnings revisions
H-EQJP-FUND.note: No authorized consensus data; no fabricated values.

H-EQJP-ASIA-REGIONAL.label: Regional Asia co-move
H-EQJP-ASIA-REGIONAL.note: Regional co-move supported; sector/tech channel is not identified.

learned: Prior US session (2026-11-05) SPY -4.41%, QQQ -6.49%, VIX +69.66%: a US-global lead is consistent, not contradicted. Using the later same-date US close would be lookahead.
Taiwan -4.51% and Korea -6.02% fell; regional Asia co-move is supported, but tech-specific attribution is unavailable.
Prior-session USDJPY -0.07%; too small to be the primary driver.
Japan-local and regional Asia explanations both survive; broad indices cannot separate them.
No scheduled policy event on the date was found in config/events.yaml; that is not proof no policy news occurred.
still_unknown: policy/news calendar coverage on the date
next_action: Retain in A/watch; acquire TOPIX sector breadth and Asia semiconductor exposure. Do not hand off unsupported deep asset research to B.
